description: This PHP class CandidateModel is part of the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin API. It models a candidate entity, implementing serialization and normalization traits, and defines properties such as id, firstName, middleName, lastName, and email for API responses.

classes.name: CandidateModel
classes.description: A model class that represents candidate data for the recruitment API, including serialization configurations and constructor initialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CandidateModel with a Candidate entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.
